svg.title: Energy gradient and directional curvature
svg.desc: E(x,y)=x²/2+2y², gradient=(x,4y), Hessian=diag(1,4). Both cuts pass through the marked atom P=(0.8,0.45). The right panel plots energy changes from P: 0.8s+s²/2 along x and 1.8s+2s² along y. The red point is s=0 on both curves. Gradient and force arrows have equal display scale and opposite directions. Viridis heatmap colors use log(1+E) to reveal variation near the minimum. All elements are editable vectors.

g.inkscape:label: b — Energy cuts and Hessian curvature
